description: React component 'TablesManager' that manages multiple categorized task lists (tables), allowing creation, renaming, selection, and deletion of tables.

methods.name: submitCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new table, invoking onCreate callback with the new table name.

methods.name: submitRename
methods.description: Handles renaming an existing table, invoking onRename callback with the table ID and new name.
